properties.urn_tabbed_markdown_state:
{"active":0,"tabs":[{"title":"URN Audio Lyrics","text":"URN Audio Lyrics
================

The first time you run this node, it will download models from hugging face, so may take a little longer ont he first run.

PURPOSE
-------
Create lyrics/transcript text from a connected AUDIO source. When Embedded Lyrics are connected (normally from URN Load Audio), they are previewed first and the user chooses whether to use them. If they are ignored or absent, the node continues through the online identification/lyrics flow and uses Whisper only as the final fallback.

INPUTS / SETTINGS
-----------------
audio_input
- Required AUDIO input.
- Connect a standard ComfyUI Load Audio node or any other AUDIO output.
- Audio_out passes this input through unchanged.

Song Analysis
- True: enable song-specific analysis. This keeps BPM/music-feature analysis, temporary vocal isolation for Whisper fallback, and conservative Verse/Chorus structure detection.
- False: skip song-structure analysis and use straightforward Whisper transcription.

Gender Vocal Determination
- True: independently enable temporary Mel-RoFormer vocal isolation plus conservative pitch analysis for `female lead vocal` / `male lead vocal`.
- False: skip the vocal-gender determination stage. Song Analysis, BPM and Verse/Chorus detection can still remain enabled.

Include timestamps
- False: Transcript_Out is readable plain text.
- True: when LRCLIB provides synced lyrics they are converted to SRT-style text. Whisper fallback also produces SRT-style timestamps.
- Lyrics.ovh is plain lyrics only, so a Lyrics.ovh result remains plain text even when this option is enabled.

Get Online Lyrics
- True (default): after the embedded-lyrics check, use the interactive online identification/lyrics flow described below.
- False: embedded lyrics are still offered first; if absent/rejected, skip online lookup and use local Whisper transcription directly.

Embedded Lyrics
- Optional STRING input, normally connected from URN Load Audio -> Embedded_Lyrics.
- When non-empty, a scrollable preview is shown before any online lookup.
- Use Embedded Lyrics returns that text immediately as Transcript_Out.
- Ignore / Search Online continues to the normal online sequence (or Whisper when Get Online Lyrics is off).
- Stop Workflow cancels the current workflow.

Artist / Title / Album
- Optional STRING metadata inputs, normally connected from URN Load Audio.
- Artist/Title take priority over Artist - Title filename parsing for online song identification and MusicBrainz metadata.
- Album is used directly when the connected metadata matches the accepted Artist/Title.
- If Album is blank, MusicBrainz automatically selects the most appropriate official release group for the accepted recording. No additional validation dialog is shown.

Status line
- Display-only status directly below Get Online Lyrics.
- Shows stages such as Searching online song titles, Waiting for song selection, Getting genre, Analysing music, Getting lyrics, Transcribing lyrics, Detecting song structure and Complete.

ONLINE LYRICS FLOW
------------------
When Get Online Lyrics is enabled, the intended sequence is:

1. Automatic filename-based search
   - The node reads the CURRENT filename from the connected upstream Load Audio/file widget.
   - Changing the selected file in the same Load Audio node refreshes the filename even when the cable remains connected.
   - The filename is used to guess Artist - Song Title and produce an alphabetically sorted title list.

2. Automatic result panel
   - Accept: use the selected artist/title and continue online.
   - Reject / Manual Search: keep the workflow paused and open the manual search stage.
   - Stop Workflow: cancel the current ComfyUI workflow cleanly.

3. Manual artist-search stage
   - Enter an artist name in the Artist name field.
   - Click Search Artist (or press Enter).
   - Matching titles for that artist are loaded into the title dropdown.
   - Use Selected: use the chosen title and continue online.
   - Reject / Use Whisper: reject the manual search and fall back to Whisper.
   - Stop Workflow: cancel the current workflow.
   - If an artist search returns no titles, the user can edit the artist name and search again without resuming the workflow.

4. Confirmed-song online lookup
   - MusicBrainz metadata lookup runs for the confirmed artist/title and automatically fills Album when connected album metadata is unavailable.
   - LRCLIB is tried first for lyrics.
   - Lyrics.ovh is tried second.
   - If neither service supplies usable lyrics, the node offers/uses the manual-search path before Whisper when appropriate; Whisper is the final fallback.

LYRIC PROVIDER ORDER
--------------------
Overall sequence:
1. Embedded metadata lyrics (when connected) - user chooses Use or Ignore
2. LRCLIB for a confirmed song identity
3. Lyrics.ovh
4. Whisper only after embedded/online/manual paths have failed or been rejected

LRCLIB
- Free/no-key source.
- Uses confirmed artist/title plus source duration and album metadata when available.
- When Include timestamps is enabled and synced LRC lyrics are available, they are converted to SRT-style Transcript_Out.

Lyrics.ovh
- Plain lyrics fallback after LRCLIB.
- Does not provide synced timestamps.

Whisper
- Local final fallback transcription.
- With Song Analysis enabled, the node can use lyric repetition/timing and supporting beat/bar analysis to attempt conservative [Verse N] / [Chorus] labels.
- Structure labels are heuristic and are not official metadata.

MUSIC DESCRIPTION
-----------------
When a song identity is confirmed, Music_Description is a comma-separated STRING for downstream style/music prompting. Song Analysis controls the BPM/music-feature contribution, while Gender Vocal Determination independently controls the conservative lead-vocal label.

MusicBrainz contributes:
- Recording/release/artist genre and community-style tags when available.
- Automatic Album lookup for a confirmed Artist/Title when no matching embedded Album metadata is available. It prefers official Album release groups, then EP, then Single; Compilation, Various Artists, Live and Remix releases are rejected entirely. Releases credited to a different known artist are also rejected; among valid matches, original artist Albums are preferred over EPs and Singles, with edition variants deprioritized and the earliest suitable release preferred.
- The confirmed title is tried exactly first.
- If confidence is poor, a fallback search removes common release/remaster decorations such as `(2015 Remaster)`, `[Remastered]`, `- Remastered 2011`, `(Deluxe Edition)` and `(Album Version)`.
- Meaningful recording qualifiers such as Live, Remix and Acoustic are preserved.

MusicBrainz tag filtering (V9.73)
- Community-edited tags are filtered BEFORE they reach Music_Description.
- The editable blocklist is:
      urn_musicbrainz_tag_blocklist.json
- Matching is normalized and whole-word based where appropriate to reduce accidental substring matches.
- Built-in default blocked terms remain active if the JSON file is missing or malformed.

Librosa contributes only:
- measured BPM when Song Analysis is enabled
- `female lead vocal` or `male lead vocal` when Gender Vocal Determination is enabled and the isolated-vocal pitch result is sufficiently clear

Librosa does NOT add generic local guesses for genre, production style, timbre, groove, bass character, dynamic range or vocal register to Music_Description.

OUTPUTS
-------
Transcript_Out
- STRING containing LRCLIB lyrics, Lyrics.ovh lyrics or Whisper transcript, depending on which source succeeds.
- With Include timestamps enabled, LRCLIB synced lyrics and Whisper fallback are SRT-style timestamped text.

Duration_Seconds
- FLOAT containing the full source audio duration in seconds.

Music_Description
- Single-line comma-separated STRING using filtered MusicBrainz tags plus available BPM and optional conservative lead-vocal label.

Audio_out
- AUDIO passthrough of the exact connected audio_input.
- No gain, resampling or transcription-related modification is applied.

Artist
- STRING containing the artist identity the user accepted.
- Embedded Lyrics acceptance uses the connected Artist metadata.
- Online acceptance uses the exact artist from the selected online result.
- Empty when no artist/title identity was accepted before Whisper fallback.

Title
- STRING containing the title identity the user accepted.
- Embedded Lyrics acceptance uses the connected Title metadata.
- Online acceptance uses the exact selected song title.
- Empty when no artist/title identity was accepted before Whisper fallback.

Album
- STRING containing the accepted/automatically resolved album identity.
- Matching embedded Album metadata from URN Load Audio has first priority.
- Otherwise MusicBrainz resolves the recording and automatically chooses the most suitable Album/EP/Single without prompting the user.
- Empty when no confident album/release match is available.


"},{"title":"URN Audio Style Selector","text":"URN Audio Style Selector
========================

PURPOSE
-------
Interactive visual review/edit node for a comma-separated music-style STRING.

INPUT
-----
Generated_Styles (STRING)
- Connect a generated style string such as URN Audio Lyrics -> Music_Description.
- Incoming/generated tags are placed in the green selected-style area and shown in GREY.

VISUAL EDITOR
-------------
Tabs
- Tabs across the top are created dynamically from the top-level keys in urn_audio_style_selector_styles.json.
- Adding a new top-level JSON section automatically creates another tab.
- The bundled categories include Genre, Vocals, Instruments, Mood, Production, Tempo, Era, BPM and User Custom.

Available tags panel
- The large available-tags area is BLACK.
- Tag label text is WHITE, including inactive/already-selected tags.
- Click an available tag to add it to the current selection.
- The active tab decides which category of tags is shown.

Selected styles panel
- The selected-style area is GREEN.
- GREY tags came through Generated_Styles.
- PURPLE tags were added by the user.
- Click ANY selected tag to remove it, including generated grey tags.

Quick Custom
- A short text field sits below the selected-style area.
- Type a missing tag and click ADD QUICK CUSTOM, or press Enter.
- The tag is immediately added to the current selection as a PURPLE user addition.
- The same tag is also saved permanently into the User Custom section of urn_audio_style_selector_styles.json.
- The User Custom tab remains visible even when it is empty.

Accept Changes
- ACCEPT CHANGES is the workflow gate.
- It outputs all currently selected tags through Final_Styles and resumes downstream execution.

OUTPUT
------
Final_Styles (STRING)
- All tags remaining in the selected-style box, joined as one comma-separated style string.

EDITABLE PRESET FILE
--------------------
urn_audio_style_selector_styles.json
- User Custom is writable from Quick Custom.
- Current preset lists are alphabetically sorted for easier browsing.
- BPM is kept in natural numeric order rather than alphabetic string order.

NOTES
-----
- The JSON is read freshed on every run
"},{"title":"URN Text Edit","text":"URN Text Edit
=============

PURPOSE
-------
Interactive workflow gate for reviewing and manually editing a Lyrics before downstream nodes continue.

INPUTS
------
source
- Required STRING input.
- Connect any text output that you want to review or modify.

HOW IT WORKS
------------
1. When workflow execution reaches URN Text Edit, the incoming text is placed in the large editor.
2. The workflow pauses at this node.
3. Edit the text as required.
4. Optional: click Save Changes to save the current editor text as a .txt file, or Load Existing to load a .txt file into the editor. Neither action resumes the workflow.
5. Click Accept Changes.
6. The edited text is returned through the STRING output and downstream execution continues.

Save Changes
- Opens the browser/OS save-file picker when supported.
- Saves the current editor contents as a .txt file only.
- Does NOT resume the workflow.

Load Existing
- Opens the browser/OS open-file picker when supported.
- Loads a .txt file into the editor, replacing the current editor text.
- Does NOT resume the workflow.

Accept Changes
- Confirms the current contents of the editor.
- This is the only one of the three buttons that resumes the workflow.
- There is no separate automatic accept; user interaction is intentional.

OUTPUTS
-------
STRING
- The final accepted text, including any manual changes made in the editor.

IMPORTANT BEHAVIOUR
-------------------
- The node is intentionally configured as an execution root/output node so ComfyUI does not prune it when a downstream node lazily consumes the string.
- It is intentionally non-cacheable/always-changed so the pause/edit/accept step happens on every queued workflow.
- Text files are written only when Save Changes is explicitly clicked.

"},{"title":"URN Audio Trim Fade","text":"URN Audio Trim Fade
===================

PURPOSE
-------
Trim an incoming AUDIO signal, add fade-in/fade-out, optionally normalize or change gain, and optionally pad the result with silence to a requested duration. ** Ideally just use the visualiser in the node rather than the controls.

INPUTS / SETTINGS
-----------------
audio_input
- Required AUDIO connection.
- Usually connect a standard ComfyUI Load Audio node or any other AUDIO output.

Length
- Set by Audio file unless overriddent when Trim Mode = Length.

Start Sec
- Absolute starting position in the source audio, in seconds.

Fade In Sec
- Length of the fade-in from silence to full level.

Fade Out Sec
- Length of the fade-out from full level to silence.

Curve
- cosine: smoother, more natural-sounding fade shape. Recommended for most audio.
- linear: changes level at a constant rate.

Pad If Short
- True: if the requested duration extends beyond the available source audio, silence is added at the end so the requested duration is still reached.
- False: output stops when the real source audio ends.

gain_db
- Final volume adjustment in decibels.
- 0 dB = unchanged.
- Negative values reduce volume; positive values increase volume.

normalize
- False: keep the original peak level before gain_db is applied.
- True: peak-normalize the trimmed real audio to 0 dBFS first, then apply gain_db.

Trim Mode
- Length: Start Sec + Length defines the selected section.
- End Sec: Start Sec and End Sec define absolute positions in the original audio.

End Sec
- Used only when Trim Mode = End Sec.
- Absolute end position in the source audio.

VISUAL EDITOR
-------------
- Outer handles control trim start/end.
- Diamond handles control Fade In/Fade Out.
- The waveform display reflects the chosen trim and fade curve.
- Preview Changes auditions the current edit locally without needing to run the whole workflow.

OUTPUTS
-------
audio
- Processed AUDIO result.

audio_duration
- Final output duration in seconds as a FLOAT.
"},{"title":"URN Audio Smart Splitter","text":"URN Audio Smart Splitter
========================

PURPOSE
-------
Automatically split a song or spoken audio into safe-length chunks while trying not to cut through words. It can transcribe the source, use isolated vocals to improve cut safety, export matching vocal chunks, and export full vocal/instrumental stems.

INPUTS / SETTINGS
-----------------
audio
- MP3/WAV/FLAC file picker.

audio_input
- Optional connected AUDIO input.
- When connected, the connected AUDIO is used and is temporarily materialized for processing.

target_length
- Preferred chunk duration in seconds.
- The splitter tries to place each cut near this length while respecting Minimum Length, Maximum Length and safe word gaps.

minimum_length
- Shortest allowed chunk duration.
- Minimum allowed setting: 5 seconds.

maximum_length
- Longest allowed chunk duration.
- Maximum allowed setting: 60 seconds.
- Target Length must remain between Minimum Length and Maximum Length.

vocal_safety
- Strong: more conservative word-edge clearance and wider vocal-energy safety checks before choosing a cut.
- Normal: slightly less conservative clearance, useful when Strong makes it difficult to find enough suitable cut points.

whisper_model
- tiny: fastest / lowest transcription accuracy.
- base: faster, modest accuracy.
- small: middle ground.
- medium: default; good accuracy/speed balance.
- large-v3: highest Whisper model quality here, but slowest and most demanding.

analysis_device
- Auto: choose an available device automatically.
- CUDA: prefer NVIDIA GPU processing.
- CPU: force CPU processing.

beam_size
- Whisper decoding beam width, 1-20.
- Larger values search more transcription alternatives and can improve accuracy at the cost of speed.

patience
- Whisper beam-search patience, 1.0-5.0.
- Higher values allow the decoder to search longer for alternatives; slower but potentially more accurate.

output_format
- FLAC: lossless chunk output; recommended/default.
- MP3: compressed chunk output.

export_vocal_stem
- True: save the full isolated vocal stem from Mel-RoFormer.
- False: do not save the full vocal stem unless it is still temporarily needed by another enabled feature.

use_vocal_stem_for_analysis
- True: use the isolated vocals for Whisper/cut-safety analysis when available.
- False: analyse the original full mix.

export_vocal_chunks
- True: export sample-aligned vocal-only chunks matching every main audio chunk.
- False: do not write vocal-only chunks.

export_music_stem
- True: save the full instrumental/music-without-vocals stem.
- False: do not save the instrumental stem.

OUTPUT FOLDERS
--------------
The node creates a source-specific folder under ComfyUI/output/audio_chunks/.
Typical subfolders include:
- chunks/          main audio chunks
- vocal_chunks/    matching vocal-only chunks
- chunk_srts/      zero-based SRT subtitles for each chunk
- chunk_text/      plain-text transcript for each chunk
- stems/           full vocal and instrumental stems
- transcripts/     full-source transcript files

OUTPUTS
-------
output_folder
- STRING path to the source-specific output folder.

debug_text
- STRING processing report containing analysis method, settings, cut-safety statistics and output paths.

transcript_srt
- Full transcription as standard SRT text.
- The same full SRT is also saved in the transcripts folder.

NOTES
-----
- The node is intentionally conservative about word boundaries. It searches for protected quiet corridors between detected words before falling back to less ideal cuts.
- Vocal and instrumental stem generation uses Mel-RoFormer/audio-separator.
"},{"title":"URN Audio Mixer","text":"URN Audio Mixer
===============

PURPOSE
-------
A lightweight multi-track timeline mixer for combining several audio files into one AUDIO output. Each track can contain multiple clips with independent position, trim and fades.

MAIN CONTROLS
-------------
Add Track
- Adds an empty mixer track.

Drop audio files in the top area
- Each dropped file creates a new track containing that file.

PREVIEW AUDIO / STOP PREVIEW
- Plays a browser-side preview of the current mix without running the full ComfyUI workflow.
- While previewing, the master slider, Play Pos readout and orange playhead move together.

Preview Position Slider
- Chooses where preview playback starts.
- Moving it while stopped immediately moves the orange playhead in every track.

PAD START (Secs)
- Whole seconds of silence added before the exported used audio span.
- Default: 0.

PAD END (Secs)
- Whole seconds of silence added after the exported used audio span.
- Default: 0.

Play Pos
- Live preview/playhead position readout.

Export Length
- Live calculated final output length, including Pad Start and Pad End.

TRACK CONTROLS
--------------
Track Volume
- 0-100% volume for every clip on that track.

Add Audio File
- Adds another clip to that same track.
- New clips are initially placed immediately after the current rightmost used clip on the track.

Remove File
- Removes only the currently selected clip on that track.
- Click a clip to select it; the selected clip is outlined in red.

Remove Track
- Removes that entire track and its clips.

CLIP / TIMELINE CONTROLS
------------------------
Drag clip horizontally
- Moves the clip left/right on the master timeline.
- Position is stored in real seconds, so timing remains stable if the timeline later grows.

Trim Start / Trim End
- Outer trim handles select the used portion of that clip.
- Trimmed-away audio is not included in the final export.

Fade In / Fade Out
- Diamond handles control clip fade durations.
- New clips default to Fade In and Fade Out equal to 5% of that source file's duration.
- Fade handles cannot cross each other.

Waveform
- Shows the source footprint, trimmed region and fade shapes.
- Multiple clips on the same track share one horizontal lane and may overlap or have gaps.

EXPORT BEHAVIOUR
----------------
- The output automatically begins at the earliest used/trimmed clip position across all tracks.
- It ends at the furthest used/trimmed clip end.
- Relative gaps and overlaps inside that used span are preserved.
- PAD START and PAD END are then added around that span.
- Final peak protection only reduces the mix when summed tracks would otherwise clip.

PERSISTENCE
-----------
Mixer state is stored with the workflow, including tracks, clips, file names, positions, trim values, fades, track volume and padding.

OUTPUTS
-------
audio
- Final mixed AUDIO result.

NOTES
-----
- There are no separate per-track AUDIO outputs; everything is mixed to one result.
- The internal mix_state_json widget is implementation storage and normally should not be edited manually.
"},{"title":"URN Audio Channel","text":"URN Audio Channel
=================

PURPOSE
-------
Visual stereo channel utility for adjusting left/right level, swapping channels, static panning, or moving a sound across the stereo field over the full clip duration.

INPUTS / SETTINGS
-----------------
audio_input
- Required AUDIO input.
- Mono audio is automatically converted to stereo so panning can work.

Left Volume
- Left-channel level from 0-200%.
- 100% = unchanged.
- Below 100% reduces the left channel; above 100% boosts it.

Right Volume
- Right-channel level from 0-200%.
- 100% = unchanged.

Swap L / R
- Off: leave channels in their original positions.
- On: exchange the left and right channels.

Pan
- Used when Auto Pan = Off.
- -100 = fully left.
- 0 = centre.
- +100 = fully right.
- The large Stereo Position handle provides the visual control for this setting.

Auto Pan
- Off: use the static Pan position.
- Left -> Right: sound moves from full left to full right over the complete input duration.
- Right -> Left: sound moves from full right to full left over the complete input duration.

Movement Curve / Pan Curve
- Cosine: smooth acceleration/deceleration through the stereo field; recommended for natural fly-by movement.
- Linear: position changes at a constant rate from one side to the other.

Prevent Clipping
- On: if the processed result would exceed the safe digital peak range, the whole result is reduced just enough to avoid clipping.
- Off: keep the requested gains exactly, even if clipping occurs.

Reset
- Restores the visual controls to their default values.

OUTPUTS
-------
audio
- Processed stereo AUDIO.

EXAMPLE
-------
For a plane passing from left to right:
- Auto Pan = Left -> Right
- Pan Curve = Cosine
- Leave Left/Right Volume at 100% unless level correction is also needed.
"},{"title":"URN Save Audio with Lyrics","text":"URN Save Audio with Lyrics
==========================

PURPOSE
-------
Saves a connected ComfyUI AUDIO stream as FLAC or MP3 while embedding Lyrics, Artist, Title and Album metadata. The output filename is controlled directly by the user and is no longer copied from the original source audio filename.


.

MP3 export requires FFmpeg in PATH.
-------

- FLAC export is lossless.
- MP3 is encoded at 320 kbps.


INPUTS
------
audio
- Required AUDIO input.

Lyrics
- Required STRING input containing the lyrics to embed.

Artist
- Optional STRING connector.
- MP3: written to ID3 TPE1.
- FLAC: written to Vorbis Comment ARTIST.

Title
- Optional STRING connector.
- MP3: written to ID3 TIT2.
- FLAC: written to Vorbis Comment TITLE.

Album
- Optional STRING connector.
- MP3: written to ID3 TALB.
- FLAC: written to Vorbis Comment ALBUM.

format
- flac
- mp3

Save Location
- Default: audio
- Relative folders are created under ComfyUI/output.
- Example: music/finished -> ComfyUI/output/music/finished/
- Absolute folders are also supported, for example:
    D:\Music\Exports

Filename
- User-controlled base filename.
- Default: audio
- The selected .flac or .mp3 extension is added automatically.
- Typing an audio extension yourself is safe; it is replaced by the selected output format.
- If a batched AUDIO payload is supplied, additional items receive _001, _002, etc.

METADATA
--------
MP3
- Lyrics: ID3 USLT (Unsynchronised Lyrics/Text)
- Artist: ID3 TPE1
- Title: ID3 TIT2
- Album: ID3 TALB
- Saved as ID3v2.3 for broad player compatibility.

FLAC
- Lyrics: Vorbis Comment LYRICS
- Artist: Vorbis Comment ARTIST
- Title: Vorbis Comment TITLE
- Album: Vorbis Comment ALBUM

OUTPUTS
-------
audio
- Unchanged AUDIO passthrough.

saved_path
- Full path to the saved file.
- Batched saves are returned as newline-separated paths.

NOTES
-----

- The node is an output node and intentionally runs every queued workflow rather than being satisfied from cache.

"},{"title":"URN Load Audio","text":"URN Load Audio
==============

If embedded information is already in the audio file, the node will pull it out and use it.

Loads an audio file from ComfyUI input and outputs:
- AUDIO
- Embedded_Lyrics
- Artist
- Title
- Album
- Source_Filename
- Metadata_JSON

Embedded lyrics created by URN Save Audio with Lyrics are recognised from here, which is common:
- MP3: ID3 USLT
- FLAC: Vorbis Comment LYRICS

Artist/title metadata can be connected to URN Audio Lyrics so online lookup does not need to guess the identity from the filename."}]}
